name: configurable-council

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Convenes a council of AI advisors you configure, from a bundled preset or a lineup you design, to pressure-test a question or decision: each advisor takes a distinct view, they critique one another anonymously, and you get one clear verdict and a first step.

description: Configurable Council: run decisions past a council of AI advisors that review each other anonymously and deliver a chairman's verdict.
